about: How long a repairable diagram's availability simulation takes (#286): ln T = intercept + log_replications * ln n + log1p_events_per_replication * ln(1 + e) + log_blocks * ln b, with log-normal residuals of spread sigma. n is the replications, e the expected block failures in one replication (each block's units times the window over its mean life), b the blocks. T is in seconds on the machine the coefficients were fitted on; machine_factors scale it to each machine Reliafy runs simulations on.
